summaryZh: Allen Lab 结合扫描探针显微与纳米制造，在纳米尺度成像和操纵量子材料。研究涉及拓扑态、强关联平带与低维量子器件，采用微波显微和电子输运测量。
topics: 强关联与低维量子器件

evidence.quote: Allen Lab Quantum Devices and Imaging
Our research combines scanning probe microscopy with nanofabrication techniques to image quantum materials and manipulate them at the nanoscale.
We employ microwave impedance microscopy and transport to probe topological states
We employ device nanofabrication and electronic transport measurements to explore quantum phenomena in reduced dimensions.
